evidence: The cold gain is the phenotype layer working on a smaller graph
observation: The built artifact was measured rather than a research variant: RGCN, 3 seeds, degree-matched, fixed held-out set, against balanced policy_context. Cold AUPRC rose 0.067 while macro fell 0.0115; the same phenotype layer on the balanced graph had measured +0.105 cold and +0.025 macro, so the gap was missing context rather than a failed layer.
subject: F-108
title: Built artifact trades macro for cold start against the balanced research graph (F-0124)
